I see you want to make several changes to an existing trip. To proceed with modifying your reservation, I first need your reservation ID.

Also, please note the following regarding your requests:
1.  **Changing the passenger to yourself:** I can help you modify passenger details, but I cannot change the number of passengers. If you are changing the passenger details, I will need the first name, last name, and date of birth for the passenger(s).
2.  **Upgrading to economy class:** This is a cabin change. I need to check if any flight segment in your reservation has already flown before I can process this.
3.  **Adding 3 checked bags:** I can update the baggage count, but I will need a payment ID associated with the reservation to process any potential charges.

Could you please provide your reservation ID so I can look up your trip details?
